content.arguments:
{"content":"<Window x:Class="StreamTranslator.App.FloatingSubtitleWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:ui="http://schemas.lepo.co/wpfui/2022/xaml"
        Title="字幕"
        Width="780"
        MinWidth="420"
        MinHeight="84"
        SizeToContent="Height"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen"
        WindowStyle="None"
        ResizeMode="NoResize"
        AllowsTransparency="True"
        Background="Transparent"
        Topmost="True"
        ShowInTaskbar="False"
        MouseEnter="OnWindowMouseEnter"
        MouseLeave="OnWindowMouseLeave"
        MouseLeftButtonDown="OnMouseLeftButtonDown">
    <Window.Resources>
        <Style x:Key="PillButtonStyle" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent" />
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#E6FFFFFF" />
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0" />
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="7,3" />
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="24" />
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="11.5" />
            <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="Medium" />
            <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand" />
            <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{x:Null}" />
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                        <Border x:Name="RootBorder"
                                Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                CornerRadius="10"
                                Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}">
                            <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                        </Border>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="RootBorder" Property="Background" Value="#2AFFFFFF" />
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FFFFFFFF" />
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsPressed" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="RootBorder" Property="Background" Value="#40FFFFFF" />
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="EdgeResizeThumbStyle" TargetType="Thumb">
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="12" />
            <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="SizeWE" />
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent" />
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Thumb">
                        <Border Background="Transparent">
                            <Border x:Name="EdgeGripLine"
                                    Width="3"
                                    Height="28"
                                    CornerRadius="1.5"
                                    Background="#70FFFFFF"
                                    HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                    VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                    Opacity="0" />
                        </Border>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="EdgeGripLine" Property="Opacity" Value="0.85" />
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsDragging" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="EdgeGripLine" Property="Opacity" Value="1" />
                                <Setter TargetName="EdgeGripLine" Property="Background" Value="#FF2DD4A3" />
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="OverlayMenuItemStyle" TargetType="MenuItem">
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#F2FFFFFF" />
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="12.5" />
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="10,6" />
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent" />
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="MenuItem">
                        <Border x:Name="MenuBorder"
                                Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                CornerRadius="5"
                                Margin="4,1"
                                Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}">
                            <Grid>
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="18" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="CheckGlyph"
                                           Grid.Column="0"
                                           Text="●"
                                           FontSize="8"
                                           Foreground="#FF2DD4A3"
                                           VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                           HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                           Visibility="Collapsed" />
                                <ContentPresenter Grid.Column="1"
                                                  ContentSource="Header"
                                                  RecognizesAccessKey="True"
                                                  VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                <TextBlock Grid.Column="2"
                                           Text="{TemplateBinding InputGestureText}"
                                           Foreground="#8AFFFFFF"
                                           FontSize="11"
                                           Margin="16,0,0,0"
                                           VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                            </Grid>
                        </Border>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsChecked" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="CheckGlyph" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible" />
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsHighlighted" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="MenuBorder" Property="Background" Value="#24FFFFFF" />
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                                <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.45" />
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="OverlayContextMenuStyle" TargetType="ContextMenu">
            <Setter Property="OverridesDefaultStyle" Value="True" />
            <Setter Property="HasDropShadow" Value="True" />
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="ContextMenu">
                        <Border Background="#F2121821"
                                BorderBrush="#33FFFFFF"
                                BorderThickness="1"
                                CornerRadius="8"
                                Padding="0,5"
                                MinWidth="196">
                            <Border.Effect>
                                <DropShadowEffect Color="#000000" BlurRadius="16" ShadowDepth="4" Opacity="0.5" />
                            </Border.Effect>
                            <StackPanel IsItemsHost="True" KeyboardNavigation.DirectionalNavigation="Cycle" />
                        </Border>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="OverlaySeparatorStyle" TargetType="Separator">
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Separator">
                        <Border Height="1" Background="#1FFFFFFF" Margin="10,4" />
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
    </Window.Resources>

    <Window.ContextMenu>
        <ContextMenu x:Name="OverlayContextMenu"
                     Style="{StaticResource OverlayContextMenuStyle}"
                     Opened="OnContextMenuOpened"
                     Closed="OnContextMenuClosed">
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuLockItem"
                      Header="锁定悬浮窗（点击穿透）"
                      InputGestureText="Ctrl+Alt+L"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnLockButtonClick" />
            <MenuItem Header="隐藏悬浮窗"
                      InputGestureText="Ctrl+Alt+H"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnHideButtonClick" />
            <Separator Style="{StaticResource OverlaySeparatorStyle}" />
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuModeTranslationFirst"
                      Header="双语 · 译文优先"
                      Tag="BilingualTranslationFirst"
                      IsCheckable="True"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnDisplayModeMenuClick" />
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuModeSourceFirst"
                      Header="双语 · 原文优先"
                      Tag="BilingualSourceFirst"
                      IsCheckable="True"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnDisplayModeMenuClick" />
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuModeTranslationOnly"
                      Header="仅显示译文"
                      Tag="TranslationOnly"
                      IsCheckable="True"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnDisplayModeMenuClick" />
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuModeSourceOnly"
                      Header="仅显示原文"
                      Tag="SourceOnly"
                      IsCheckable="True"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnDisplayModeMenuClick" />
            <Separator Style="{StaticResource OverlaySeparatorStyle}" />
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuThemeCinemaGlass"
                      Header="皮肤 · 影院暗玻璃"
                      Tag="CinemaGlass"
                      IsCheckable="True"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnThemeMenuClick" />
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuThemeHighContrast"
                      Header="皮肤 · 亮底高对比"
                      Tag="HighContrast"
                      IsCheckable="True"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnThemeMenuClick" />
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuThemeMinimalFloating"
                      Header="皮肤 · 极简浮字"
                      Tag="MinimalFloating"
                      IsCheckable="True"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnThemeMenuClick" />
            <Separator Style="{StaticResource OverlaySeparatorStyle}" />
            <MenuItem Header="增大字号"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnIncreaseFontClick" />
            <MenuItem Header="减小字号"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnDecreaseFontClick" />
            <MenuItem Header="重置位置到屏幕底部居中"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnResetPositionClick" />
            <Separator Style="{StaticResource OverlaySeparatorStyle}" />
            <MenuItem Header="打开主窗口设置"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnOpenSettingsClick" />
        </ContextMenu>
    </Window.ContextMenu>

    <!-- 顶部预留 28px 悬停微控胶囊区域，让工具栏浮在字幕面板上方而不挤动字幕高度 -->
    <Grid Margin="10,2,10,12">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="28" />
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <!-- 悬停微控胶囊栏（仅未锁定且鼠标移入时淡入） -->
        <Border x:Name="HoverToolbar"
                Grid.Row="0"
                HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                VerticalAlignment="Bottom"
                Margin="0,0,0,4"
                CornerRadius="13"
                Background="#E8111720"
                BorderBrush="#36FFFFFF"
                BorderThickness="1"
                Padding="6,1"
                Opacity="0"
                IsHitTestVisible="False">
            <Border.Effect>
                <DropShadowEffect Color="#000000" BlurRadius="12" ShadowDepth="2" Opacity="0.45" />
            </Border.Effect>
            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                <TextBlock Text="⠿"
                           Foreground="#88FFFFFF"
                           FontSize="12"
                           VerticalAlignment="Center"
                           Margin="4,0,6,0"
                           ToolTip="按住拖动移动位置" />
                <Border Width="1" Height="12" Background="#26FFFFFF" Margin="0,0,4,0" />
                <Button Content="A-"
                        ToolTip="减小字号"

{"content":"<Window x:Class="StreamTranslator.App.FloatingSubtitleWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:ui="http://schemas.lepo.co/wpfui/2022/xaml"
        Title="字幕"
        Width="780"
        MinWidth="420"
        MinHeight="84"
        SizeToContent="Height"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen"
        WindowStyle="None"
        ResizeMode="NoResize"
        AllowsTransparency="True"
        Background="Transparent"
        Topmost="True"
        ShowInTaskbar="False"
        MouseEnter="OnWindowMouseEnter"
        MouseLeave="OnWindowMouseLeave"
        MouseLeftButtonDown="OnMouseLeftButtonDown">
    <Window.Resources>
        <Style x:Key="PillButtonStyle" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent" />
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#E6FFFFFF" />
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0" />
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="7,3" />
            <Setter Property="Height" Value="24" />
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="11.5" />
            <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="Medium" />
            <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand" />
            <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{x:Null}" />
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                        <Border x:Name="RootBorder"
                                Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                CornerRadius="10"
                                Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}">
                            <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                        </Border>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="RootBorder" Property="Background" Value="#2AFFFFFF" />
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FFFFFFFF" />
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsPressed" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="RootBorder" Property="Background" Value="#40FFFFFF" />
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="EdgeResizeThumbStyle" TargetType="Thumb">
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="12" />
            <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="SizeWE" />
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent" />
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Thumb">
                        <Border Background="Transparent">
                            <Border x:Name="EdgeGripLine"
                                    Width="3"
                                    Height="28"
                                    CornerRadius="1.5"
                                    Background="#70FFFFFF"
                                    HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                    VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                    Opacity="0" />
                        </Border>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="EdgeGripLine" Property="Opacity" Value="0.85" />
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsDragging" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="EdgeGripLine" Property="Opacity" Value="1" />
                                <Setter TargetName="EdgeGripLine" Property="Background" Value="#FF2DD4A3" />
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="OverlayMenuItemStyle" TargetType="MenuItem">
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#F2FFFFFF" />
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="12.5" />
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="10,6" />
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent" />
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="MenuItem">
                        <Border x:Name="MenuBorder"
                                Background="{TemplateBinding Background}"
                                CornerRadius="5"
                                Margin="4,1"
                                Padding="{TemplateBinding Padding}">
                            <Grid>
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="18" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="CheckGlyph"
                                           Grid.Column="0"
                                           Text="●"
                                           FontSize="8"
                                           Foreground="#FF2DD4A3"
                                           VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                           HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                           Visibility="Collapsed" />
                                <ContentPresenter Grid.Column="1"
                                                  ContentSource="Header"
                                                  RecognizesAccessKey="True"
                                                  VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                <TextBlock Grid.Column="2"
                                           Text="{TemplateBinding InputGestureText}"
                                           Foreground="#8AFFFFFF"
                                           FontSize="11"
                                           Margin="16,0,0,0"
                                           VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                            </Grid>
                        </Border>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsChecked" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="CheckGlyph" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible" />
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsHighlighted" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="MenuBorder" Property="Background" Value="#24FFFFFF" />
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                                <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.45" />
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="OverlayContextMenuStyle" TargetType="ContextMenu">
            <Setter Property="OverridesDefaultStyle" Value="True" />
            <Setter Property="HasDropShadow" Value="True" />
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="ContextMenu">
                        <Border Background="#F2121821"
                                BorderBrush="#33FFFFFF"
                                BorderThickness="1"
                                CornerRadius="8"
                                Padding="0,5"
                                MinWidth="196">
                            <Border.Effect>
                                <DropShadowEffect Color="#000000" BlurRadius="16" ShadowDepth="4" Opacity="0.5" />
                            </Border.Effect>
                            <StackPanel IsItemsHost="True" KeyboardNavigation.DirectionalNavigation="Cycle" />
                        </Border>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="OverlaySeparatorStyle" TargetType="Separator">
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Separator">
                        <Border Height="1" Background="#1FFFFFFF" Margin="10,4" />
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
    </Window.Resources>

    <Window.ContextMenu>
        <ContextMenu x:Name="OverlayContextMenu"
                     Style="{StaticResource OverlayContextMenuStyle}"
                     Opened="OnContextMenuOpened"
                     Closed="OnContextMenuClosed">
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuLockItem"
                      Header="锁定悬浮窗（点击穿透）"
                      InputGestureText="Ctrl+Alt+L"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnLockButtonClick" />
            <MenuItem Header="隐藏悬浮窗"
                      InputGestureText="Ctrl+Alt+H"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnHideButtonClick" />
            <Separator Style="{StaticResource OverlaySeparatorStyle}" />
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuModeTranslationFirst"
                      Header="双语 · 译文优先"
                      Tag="BilingualTranslationFirst"
                      IsCheckable="True"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnDisplayModeMenuClick" />
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuModeSourceFirst"
                      Header="双语 · 原文优先"
                      Tag="BilingualSourceFirst"
                      IsCheckable="True"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnDisplayModeMenuClick" />
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuModeTranslationOnly"
                      Header="仅显示译文"
                      Tag="TranslationOnly"
                      IsCheckable="True"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnDisplayModeMenuClick" />
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuModeSourceOnly"
                      Header="仅显示原文"
                      Tag="SourceOnly"
                      IsCheckable="True"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnDisplayModeMenuClick" />
            <Separator Style="{StaticResource OverlaySeparatorStyle}" />
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuThemeCinemaGlass"
                      Header="皮肤 · 影院暗玻璃"
                      Tag="CinemaGlass"
                      IsCheckable="True"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnThemeMenuClick" />
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuThemeHighContrast"
                      Header="皮肤 · 亮底高对比"
                      Tag="HighContrast"
                      IsCheckable="True"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnThemeMenuClick" />
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuThemeMinimalFloating"
                      Header="皮肤 · 极简浮字"
                      Tag="MinimalFloating"
                      IsCheckable="True"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnThemeMenuClick" />
            <Separator Style="{StaticResource OverlaySeparatorStyle}" />
            <MenuItem Header="增大字号"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnIncreaseFontClick" />
            <MenuItem Header="减小字号"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnDecreaseFontClick" />
            <MenuItem Header="重置位置到屏幕底部居中"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnResetPositionClick" />
            <Separator Style="{StaticResource OverlaySeparatorStyle}" />
            <MenuItem Header="打开主窗口设置"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnOpenSettingsClick" />
        </ContextMenu>
    </Window.ContextMenu>

    <!-- 顶部预留 28px 悬停微控胶囊区域，让工具栏浮在字幕面板上方而不挤动字幕高度 -->
    <Grid Margin="10,2,10,12">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="28" />
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <!-- 悬停微控胶囊栏（仅未锁定且鼠标移入时淡入） -->
        <Border x:Name="HoverToolbar"
                Grid.Row="0"
                HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                VerticalAlignment="Bottom"
                Margin="0,0,0,4"
                CornerRadius="13"
                Background="#E8111720"
                BorderBrush="#36FFFFFF"
                BorderThickness="1"
                Padding="6,1"
                Opacity="0"
                IsHitTestVisible="False">
            <Border.Effect>
                <DropShadowEffect Color="#000000" BlurRadius="12" ShadowDepth="2" Opacity="0.45" />
            </Border.Effect>
            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                <TextBlock Text="⠿"
                           Foreground="#88FFFFFF"
                           FontSize="12"
                           VerticalAlignment="Center"
                           Margin="4,0,6,0"
                           ToolTip="按住拖动移动位置" />
                <Border Width="1" Height="12" Background="#26FFFFFF" Margin="0,0,4,0" />
                <Button Content="A-"
                        ToolTip="减小字号"
                        Style="{StaticResource PillButtonStyle}"
                        Click="OnDecreaseFontClick" />
                <TextBlock x:Name="PillFontSizeText"
                           Text="18"
                           Foreground="#B8FFFFFF"
                           FontSize="11"
                           VerticalAlignment="Center"
                           Margin="2,0"
                           Typography.NumeralAlignment="Tabular" />
                <Button Content="A+"
                        ToolTip="增大字号"
                        Style="{StaticResource PillButtonStyle}"
                        Click="OnIncreaseFontClick" />
                <Border Width="1" Height="12" Background="#26FFFFFF" Margin="4,0" />
                <Button x:Name="PillDisplayModeButton"
                        Content="双语·原文"
                        ToolTip="点击切换双语/单语显示模式"
                        Style="{StaticResource PillButtonStyle}"
                        Click="OnCycleDisplayModeClick" />
                <Button x:Name="PillThemeButton"
                        Content="暗玻璃"
                        ToolTip="点击切换可读性皮肤预设"
                        Style="{StaticResource PillButtonStyle}"
                        Click="OnCycleThemeClick" />
                <Border Width="1" Height="12" Background="#26FFFFFF" Margin="4,0" />
                <Button x:Name="PillLockButton"
                        ToolTip="锁定悬浮窗（点击穿透，Ctrl+Alt+L 解锁）"
                        Style="{StaticResource PillButtonStyle}"
                        Click="OnLockButtonClick">
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                        <ui:SymbolIcon Symbol="LockClosed20" FontSize="12" Margin="0,0,4,0" />
                        <TextBlock Text="锁定" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                    </StackPanel>
                </Button>
                <Button ToolTip="打开主窗口"
                        Style="{StaticResource PillButtonStyle}"
                        Click="OnOpenSettingsClick">
                    <ui:SymbolIcon Symbol="Settings20" FontSize="12" />
                </Button>
                <Button ToolTip="隐藏悬浮窗 (Ctrl+Alt+H)"
                        Style="{StaticResource PillButtonStyle}"
                        Click="OnHideButtonClick">
                    <ui:SymbolIcon Symbol="Dismiss20" FontSize="11" />
                </Button>
            </StackPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- 主字幕面板 -->
        <Border x:Name="Chrome"
                Grid.Row="1"
                CornerRadius="12"
                BorderThickness="1"
                Padding="22,13,22,14">
            <Border.Background>
                <SolidColorBrush x:Name="ChromeBackgroundBrush" Color="#0F141B" Opacity="0.72" />
            </Border.Background>
            <Border.BorderBrush>
                <LinearGradientBrush x:Name="ChromeBorderBrush" StartPoint="0,0" EndPoint="0,1">
                    <GradientStop x:Name="ChromeBorderTopStop" Color="#3DFFFFFF" Offset="0" />
                    <GradientStop x:Name="ChromeBorderBottomStop" Color="#14FFFFFF" Offset="1" />
                </LinearGradientBrush>
            </Border.BorderBrush>
            <Border.Effect>
                <DropShadowEffect x:Name="ChromeShadowEffect"
                                  Color="#000000"
                                  BlurRadius="20"
                                  ShadowDepth="4"
                                  Direction="270"
                                  Opacity="0.46" />
            </Border.Effect>

            <Grid>
                <!-- 字幕条目列表 -->
                <ItemsControl x:Name="SubtitleGroups"
                              ItemsSource="{Binding Entries, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}"
                              HorizontalContentAlignment="Stretch">
                    <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                        <DataTemplate>
                            <StackPanel x:Name="EntryRoot"
                                        Margin="0,4"
                                        Opacity="{Binding EmphasisOpacity}"
                                        RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                                <StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                                    <TranslateTransform Y="0" />
                                </StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                                <StackPanel.Triggers>
                                    <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="FrameworkElement.Loaded">
                                        <BeginStoryboard>
                                            <Storyboard>
                                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TranslateTransform.Y)"
                                                                 From="5"
                                                                 To="0"
                                                                 Duration="0:0:0.18">
                                                    <DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction>
                                                        <CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut" />
                                                    </DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction>
                                                </DoubleAnimation>
                                            </Storyboard>
                                        </BeginStoryboard>
                                    </EventTrigger>
                                </StackPanel.Triggers>

                                <!-- 第一行（按 DisplayMode 决定是原文还是译文） -->
                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding PrimaryLineText}"
                                           Visibility="{Binding PrimaryLineVisibility}"
                                           Foreground="{Binding PrimaryLineBrush}"
                                           FontSize="{Binding PrimaryLineFontSize}"
                                           FontWeight="{Binding PrimaryLineFontWeight}"
                                           TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                           TextAlignment="Center"
                                           LineStackingStrategy="BlockLineHeight"
                                           Effect="{DynamicResource FloatingTextShadowEffect}" />

                                <!-- 第二行（按 DisplayMode 决定是译文、原文或隐藏） -->
                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding SecondaryLineText}"
                                           Visibility="{Binding SecondaryLineVisibility}"
                                           Foreground="{Binding SecondaryLineBrush}"
                                           FontSize="{Binding SecondaryLineFontSize}"
                                           FontWeight="{Binding SecondaryLineFontWeight}"
                                           TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                           TextAlignment="Center"
                                           Margin="0,3,0,0"
                                           LineStackingStrategy="BlockLineHeight"
                                           Effect="{DynamicResource FloatingTextShadowEffect}" />
                            </StackPanel>
                        </DataTemplate>
                    </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                </ItemsControl>

                <!-- 锁定/解锁短提示气泡 -->
                <Border x:Name="LockHint"
                        HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                        VerticalAlignment="Top"
                        Margin="0,-6,0,0"
                        Padding="12,4"
                        CornerRadius="12"
                        Background="#D80B1017"
                        BorderBrush="#36FFFFFF"
                        BorderThickness="1"
                        Visibility="Collapsed"
                        IsHitTestVisible="False">
                    <TextBlock x:Name="LockHintText"
                               Text=""
                               Foreground="#F5FFFFFF"
                               FontSize="12" />
                </Border>

                <!-- 底部 2px 声学 / 识别微光呼吸条（消除 VAD 停顿等待期的“是否卡死”焦虑） -->
                <Border x:Name="ActivityTrack"
                        HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                        VerticalAlignment="Bottom"
                        Margin="0,0,0,-9"
                        Height="2.5"
                        Width="140"
                        CornerRadius="1.25"
                        Background="#18FFFFFF"
                        Opacity="0"
                        IsHitTestVisible="False">
                    <Border x:Name="ActivityBar"
                            HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                            Height="2.5"
                            Width="36"
                            CornerRadius="1.25"
                            Background="#FF2DD4A3">
                        <Border.Effect>
                            <DropShadowEffect x:Name="ActivityGlow"
                                              Color="#2DD4A3"
                                              BlurRadius="8"
                                              ShadowDepth="0"
                                              Opacity="0.8" />
                        </Border.Effect>
                    </Border>
                </Border>
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <!-- 左右隐形边缘缩放手柄，替代违和的 Win32 ResizeGrip 灰点 -->
        <Thumb x:Name="LeftResizeThumb"
               Grid.Row="1"
               HorizontalAlignment="Left"
               Margin="-2,8,0,8"
               Style="{StaticResource EdgeResizeThumbStyle}"
               DragDelta="OnLeftResizeDragDelta" />
        <Thumb x:Name="RightResizeThumb"
               Grid.Row="1"
               HorizontalAlignment="Right"
               Margin="0,8,-2,8"
               Style="{StaticResource EdgeResizeThumbStyle}"
               DragDelta="OnRightResizeDragDelta" />
    </Grid>
</Window>

                                MinWidth="196">

                                <DropShadowEffect Color="#000000" BlurRadius="16" ShadowDepth="4" Opacity="0.5" />

                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
    </Window.Resources>

    <Window.ContextMenu>
        <ContextMenu x:Name="OverlayContextMenu"
                     Style="{StaticResource OverlayContextMenuStyle}"
                     Opened="OnContextMenuOpened"
                     Closed="OnContextMenuClosed">
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuLockItem"
                      Header="锁定悬浮窗（点击穿透）"
                      InputGestureText="Ctrl+Alt+L"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnLockButtonClick" />
            <MenuItem Header="隐藏悬浮窗"
                      InputGestureText="Ctrl+Alt+H"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnHideButtonClick" />
            <Separator Style="{StaticResource OverlaySeparatorStyle}" />
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuModeTranslationFirst"
                      Header="双语 · 译文优先"
                      Tag="BilingualTranslationFirst"
                      IsCheckable="True"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnDisplayModeMenuClick" />
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuModeSourceFirst"
                      Header="双语 · 原文优先"
                      Tag="BilingualSourceFirst"
                      IsCheckable="True"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnDisplayModeMenuClick" />
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuModeTranslationOnly"
                      Header="仅显示译文"
                      Tag="TranslationOnly"
                      IsCheckable="True"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnDisplayModeMenuClick" />
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuModeSourceOnly"
                      Header="仅显示原文"
                      Tag="SourceOnly"
                      IsCheckable="True"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnDisplayModeMenuClick" />
            <Separator Style="{StaticResource OverlaySeparatorStyle}" />
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuThemeCinemaGlass"
                      Header="皮肤 · 影院暗玻璃"
                      Tag="CinemaGlass"
                      IsCheckable="True"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnThemeMenuClick" />
            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuThemeHighContrast"
                      Header="皮肤 · 亮底高对比"
                      Tag="HighContrast"
                      IsCheckable="True"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"

            <MenuItem x:Name="MenuThemeMinimalFloating"
                      Header="皮肤 · 极简浮字"
                      Tag="MinimalFloating"
                      IsCheckable="True"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnThemeMenuClick" />
            <Separator Style="{StaticResource OverlaySeparatorStyle}" />
            <MenuItem Header="增大字号"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnIncreaseFontClick" />
            <MenuItem Header="减小字号"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnDecreaseFontClick" />
            <MenuItem Header="重置位置到屏幕底部居中"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnResetPositionClick" />
            <Separator Style="{StaticResource OverlaySeparatorStyle}" />
            <MenuItem Header="打开主窗口设置"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnOpenSettingsClick" />
        </ContextMenu>
    </Window.ContextMenu>

    <!-- 顶部预留 28px 悬停微控胶囊区域，让工具栏浮在字幕面板上方而不挤动字幕高度 -->
    <Grid Margin="10,2,10,12">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="28" />
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <!-- 悬停微控胶囊栏（仅未锁定且鼠标移入时淡入） -->
        <Border x:Name="HoverToolbar"
                Grid.Row="0"
                HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                VerticalAlignment="Bottom"
                Margin="0,0,0,4"
                CornerRadius="13"
                Background="#E8111720"
                BorderBrush="#36FFFFFF"
                BorderThickness="1"
                Padding="6,1"
                Opacity="0"
                IsHitTestVisible="False">
            <Border.Effect>
                <DropShadowEffect Color="#000000" BlurRadius="12" ShadowDepth="2" Opacity="0.45" />
            </Border.Effect>
            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                <TextBlock Text="⠿"
                           Foreground="#88FFFFFF"
                           FontSize="12"
                           VerticalAlignment="Center"
                           Margin="4,0,6,0"
                           ToolTip="按住拖动移动位置" />
                <Border Width="1" Height="12" Background="#26FFFFFF" Margin="0,0,4,0" />
                <Button Content="A-"
                        ToolTip="减小字号"
                        Style="{StaticResource PillButtonStyle}"
                        Click="OnDecreaseFontClick" />
                <TextBlock x:Name="PillFontSizeText"
                           Text="18"
                           Foreground="#B8FFFFFF"
                           FontSize="11"
                           VerticalAlignment="Center"
                           Margin="2,0"
                           Typography.NumeralAlignment="Tabular" />
                <Button Content="A+"
                        ToolTip="增大字号"
                        Style="{StaticResource PillButtonStyle}"
                        Click="OnIncreaseFontClick" />
                <Border Width="1" Height="12" Background="#26FFFFFF" Margin="4,0" />
                <Button x:Name="PillDisplayModeButton"
                        Content="双语·原文"
                        ToolTip="点击切换双语/单语显示模式"
                        Style="{StaticResource PillButtonStyle}"
                        Click="OnCycleDisplayModeClick" />
                <Button x:Name="PillThemeButton"
                        Content="暗玻璃"
                        ToolTip="点击切换可读性皮肤预设"
                        Style="{StaticResource PillButtonStyle}"
                        Click="OnCycleThemeClick" />
                <Border Width="1" Height="12" Background="#26FFFFFF" Margin="4,0" />
                <Button x:Name="PillLockButton"
                        ToolTip="锁定悬浮窗（点击穿透，Ctrl+Alt+L 解锁）"
                        Style="{StaticResource PillButtonStyle}"
                        Click="OnLockButtonClick">
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                        <ui:SymbolIcon Symbol="LockClosed20" FontSize="12" Margin="0,0,4,0" />
                        <TextBlock Text="锁定" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                    </StackPanel>
                </Button>
                <Button ToolTip="打开主窗口"
                        Style="{StaticResource PillButtonStyle}"
                        Click="OnOpenSettingsClick">
                    <ui:SymbolIcon Symbol="Settings20" FontSize="12" />
                </Button>
                <Button ToolTip="隐藏悬浮窗 (Ctrl+Alt+H)"
                        Style="{StaticResource PillButtonStyle}"
                        Click="OnHideButtonClick">
                    <ui:SymbolIcon Symbol="Dismiss20" FontSize="11" />
                </Button>
            </StackPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- 主字幕面板 -->
        <Border x:Name="Chrome"
                Grid.Row="1"
                CornerRadius="12"
                BorderThickness="1"
                Padding="22,13,22,14">
            <Border.Background>
                <SolidColorBrush x:Name="ChromeBackgroundBrush" Color="#0F141B" Opacity="0.72" />
            </Border.Background>
            <Border.BorderBrush>
                <LinearGradientBrush x:Name="ChromeBorderBrush" StartPoint="0,0" EndPoint="0,1">
                    <GradientStop x:Name="ChromeBorderTopStop" Color="#3DFFFFFF" Offset="0" />
                    <GradientStop x:Name="ChromeBorderBottomStop" Color="#14FFFFFF" Offset="1" />

            <Border.Effect>
                <DropShadowEffect x:Name="ChromeShadowEffect"
                                  Color="#000000"
                                  BlurRadius="20"
                                  ShadowDepth="4"
                                  Direction="270"
                                  Opacity="0.46" />
            </Border.Effect>

                <!-- 字幕条目列表 -->
                <ItemsControl x:Name="SubtitleGroups"
                              ItemsSource="{Binding Entries, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}"
                              HorizontalContentAlignment="Stretch">
                    <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                        <DataTemplate>
                            <StackPanel x:Name="EntryRoot"
                                        Margin="0,4"
                                        Opacity="{Binding EmphasisOpacity}"
                                        RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                                <StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                                    <TranslateTransform Y="0" />
                                </StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                                <StackPanel.Triggers>
                                    <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="FrameworkElement.Loaded">
                                        <BeginStoryboard>
                                            <Storyboard>
                                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TranslateTransform.Y)"
                                                                 From="5"
                                                                 To="0"
                                                                 Duration="0:0:0.18">
                                                    <DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction>
                                                        <CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut" />
                                                    </DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction>
                                                </DoubleAnimation>
                                            </Storyboard>
                                        </BeginStoryboard>
                                    </EventTrigger>
                                </StackPanel.Triggers>

                                <!-- 第一行（按 DisplayMode 决定是原文还是译文） -->
                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding PrimaryLineText}"
                                           Visibility="{Binding PrimaryLineVisibility}"
                                           Foreground="{Binding PrimaryLineBrush}"
                                           FontSize="{Binding PrimaryLineFontSize}"
                                           FontWeight="{Binding PrimaryLineFontWeight}"
                                           TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                           TextAlignment="Center"
                                           LineStackingStrategy="BlockLineHeight"
                                           Effect="{DynamicResource FloatingTextShadowEffect}" />

                                <!-- 第二行（按 DisplayMode 决定是译文、原文或隐藏） -->
                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding SecondaryLineText}"
                                           Visibility="{Binding SecondaryLineVisibility}"
                                           Foreground="{Binding SecondaryLineBrush}"
                                           FontSize="{Binding SecondaryLineFontSize}"
                                           FontWeight="{Binding SecondaryLineFontWeight}"
                                           TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                           TextAlignment="Center"
                                           Margin="0,3,0,0"
                                           LineStackingStrategy="BlockLineHeight"
                                           Effect="{DynamicResource FloatingTextShadowEffect}" />
                            </StackPanel>
                        </DataTemplate>
                    </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                </ItemsControl>

                <!-- 锁定/解锁短提示气泡 -->
                <Border x:Name="LockHint"
                        HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                        VerticalAlignment="Top"
                        Margin="0,-6,0,0"
                        Padding="12,4"
                        CornerRadius="12"
                        Background="#D80B1017"
                        BorderBrush="#36FFFFFF"
                        BorderThickness="1"
                        Visibility="Collapsed"
                        IsHitTestVisible="False">
                    <TextBlock x:Name="LockHintText"
                               Text=""
                               Foreground="#F5FFFFFF"
                               FontSize="12" />
                </Border>

                <!-- 底部 2px 声学 / 识别微光呼吸条（消除 VAD 停顿等待期的“是否卡死”焦虑） -->
                <Border x:Name="ActivityTrack"
                        HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                        VerticalAlignment="Bottom"
                        Margin="0,0,0,-9"
                        Height="2.5"
                        Width="140"
                        CornerRadius="1.25"
                        Background="#18FFFFFF"
                        Opacity="0"
                        IsHitTestVisible="False">
                    <Border x:Name="ActivityBar"
                            HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                            Height="2.5"
                            Width="36"
                            CornerRadius="1.25"
                            Background="#FF2DD4A3">
                        <Border.Effect>
                            <DropShadowEffect x:Name="ActivityGlow"
                                              Color="#2DD4A3"
                                              BlurRadius="8"
                                              ShadowDepth="0"
                                              Opacity="0.8" />
                        </Border.Effect>
                    </Border>
                </Border>
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <!-- 左右隐形边缘缩放手柄，替代违和的 Win32 ResizeGrip 灰点 -->
        <Thumb x:Name="LeftResizeThumb"
               Grid.Row="1"
               HorizontalAlignment="Left"
               Margin="-2,8,0,8"
               Style="{StaticResource EdgeResizeThumbStyle}"
               DragDelta="OnLeftResizeDragDelta" />
        <Thumb x:Name="RightResizeThumb"
               Grid.Row="1"
               HorizontalAlignment="Right"
               Margin="0,8,-2,8"
               Style="{StaticResource EdgeResizeThumbStyle}"
               DragDelta="OnRightResizeDragDelta" />
    </Grid>
</Window>

                      Click="OnResetPositionClick" />
            <Separator Style="{StaticResource OverlaySeparatorStyle}" />
            <MenuItem Header="打开主窗口设置"
                      Style="{StaticResource OverlayMenuItemStyle}"
                      Click="OnOpenSettingsClick" />
        </ContextMenu>
    </Window.ContextMenu>

    <!-- 顶部预留 28px 悬停微控胶囊区域，让工具栏浮在字幕面板上方而不挤动字幕高度 -->
    <Grid Margin="10,2,10,12">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="28" />
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <!-- 悬停微控胶囊栏（仅未锁定且鼠标移入时淡入） -->
        <Border x:Name="HoverToolbar"
                Grid.Row="0"
                HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                VerticalAlignment="Bottom"
                Margin="0,0,0,4"
                CornerRadius="13"
                Background="#E8111720"
                BorderBrush="#36FFFFFF"
                BorderThickness="1"
                Padding="6,1"
                Opacity="0"
                IsHitTestVisible="False">
            <Border.Effect>
                <DropShadowEffect Color="#000000" BlurRadius="12" ShadowDepth="2" Opacity="0.45" />
            </Border.Effect>
            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                <TextBlock Text="⠿"
                           Foreground="#88FFFFFF"
                           FontSize="12"
                           VerticalAlignment="Center"
                           Margin="4,0,6,0"
                           ToolTip="按住拖动移动位置" />
                <Border Width="1" Height="12" Background="#26FFFFFF" Margin="0,0,4,0" />
                <Button Content="A-"
                        ToolTip="减小字号"
                        Style="{StaticResource PillButtonStyle}"
                        Click="OnDecreaseFontClick" />
                <TextBlock x:Name="PillFontSizeText"
                           Text="18"
                           Foreground="#B8FFFFFF"
                           FontSize="11"
                           VerticalAlignment="Center"
                           Margin="2,0"
                           Typography.NumeralAlignment="Tabular" />
                <Button Content="A+"
                        ToolTip="增大字号"
                        Style="{StaticResource PillButtonStyle}"
                        Click="OnIncreaseFontClick" />
                <Border Width="1" Height="12" Background="#26FFFFFF" Margin="4,0" />
                <Button x:Name="PillDisplayModeButton"
                        Content="双语·原文"
                        ToolTip="点击切换双语/单语显示模式"
                        Style="{StaticResource PillButtonStyle}"
                        Click="OnCycleDisplayModeClick" />
                <Button x:Name="PillThemeButton"
                        Content="暗玻璃"
                        ToolTip="点击切换可读性皮肤预设"
                        Style="{StaticResource PillButtonStyle}"
                        Click="OnCycleThemeClick" />
                <Border Width="1" Height="12" Background="#26FFFFFF" Margin="4,0" />
                <Button x:Name="PillLockButton"
                        ToolTip="锁定悬浮窗（点击穿透，Ctrl+Alt+L 解锁）"
                        Style="{StaticResource PillButtonStyle}"
                        Click="OnLockButtonClick">
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                        <ui:SymbolIcon Symbol="LockClosed20" FontSize="12" Margin="0,0,4,0" />
                        <TextBlock Text="锁定" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                    </StackPanel>
                </Button>
                <Button ToolTip="打开主窗口"
                        Style="{StaticResource PillButtonStyle}"
                        Click="OnOpenSettingsClick">
                    <ui:SymbolIcon Symbol="Settings20" FontSize="12" />
                </Button>
                <Button ToolTip="隐藏悬浮窗 (Ctrl+Alt+H)"
                        Style="{StaticResource PillButtonStyle}"
                        Click="OnHideButtonClick">
                    <ui:SymbolIcon Symbol="Dismiss20" FontSize="11" />
                </Button>
            </StackPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- 主字幕面板 -->
        <Border x:Name="Chrome"
                Grid.Row="1"
                CornerRadius="12"
                BorderThickness="1"
                Padding="22,13,22,14">
            <Border.Background>
                <SolidColorBrush x:Name="ChromeBackgroundBrush" Color="#0F141B" Opacity="0.72" />
            </Border.Background>
            <Border.BorderBrush>
                <LinearGradientBrush x:Name="ChromeBorderBrush" StartPoint="0,0" EndPoint="0,1">
                    <GradientStop x:Name="ChromeBorderTopStop" Color="#3DFFFFFF" Offset="0" />
                    <GradientStop x:Name="ChromeBorderBottomStop" Color="#14FFFFFF" Offset="1" />
                </LinearGradientBrush>
            </Border.BorderBrush>
            <Border.Effect>
                <DropShadowEffect x:Name="ChromeShadowEffect"
                                  Color="#000000"
                                  BlurRadius="20"
                                  ShadowDepth="4"
                                  Direction="270"
                                  Opacity="0.46" />
            </Border.Effect>

            <Grid>
                <!-- 字幕条目列表 -->
                <ItemsControl x:Name="SubtitleGroups"
                              ItemsSource="{Binding Entries, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=Window}}"
                              HorizontalContentAlignment="Stretch">
                    <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                        <DataTemplate>
                            <StackPanel x:Name="EntryRoot"
                                        Margin="0,4"
                                        Opacity="{Binding EmphasisOpacity}"
                                        RenderTransformOrigin="0.5,0.5">
                                <StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                                    <TranslateTransform Y="0" />
                                </StackPanel.RenderTransform>
                                <StackPanel.Triggers>
                                    <EventTrigger RoutedEvent="FrameworkElement.Loaded">
                                        <BeginStoryboard>
                                            <Storyboard>
                                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TranslateTransform.Y)"
                                                                 From="5"
                                                                 To="0"
                                                                 Duration="0:0:0.18">
                                                    <DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction>
                                                        <CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut" />
                                                    </DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction>
                                                </DoubleAnimation>
                                            </Storyboard>
                                        </BeginStoryboard>
                                    </EventTrigger>
                                </StackPanel.Triggers>

                                <!-- 第一行（按 DisplayMode 决定是原文还是译文） -->
                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding PrimaryLineText}"
                                           Visibility="{Binding PrimaryLineVisibility}"
                                           Foreground="{Binding PrimaryLineBrush}"
                                           FontSize="{Binding PrimaryLineFontSize}"
                                           FontWeight="{Binding PrimaryLineFontWeight}"
                                           TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                           TextAlignment="Center"
                                           LineStackingStrategy="BlockLineHeight"
                                           Effect="{DynamicResource FloatingTextShadowEffect}" />

                                <!-- 第二行（按 DisplayMode 决定是译文、原文或隐藏） -->
                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding SecondaryLineText}"
                                           Visibility="{Binding SecondaryLineVisibility}"
                                           Foreground="{Binding SecondaryLineBrush}"
                                           FontSize="{Binding SecondaryLineFontSize}"
                                           FontWeight="{Binding SecondaryLineFontWeight}"
                                           TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                           TextAlignment="Center"
                                           Margin="0,3,0,0"
                                           LineStackingStrategy="BlockLineHeight"
                                           Effect="{DynamicResource FloatingTextShadowEffect}" />
                            </StackPanel>
                        </DataTemplate>
                    </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                </ItemsControl>

                <!-- 锁定/解锁短提示气泡 -->
                <Border x:Name="LockHint"
                        HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                        VerticalAlignment="Top"
                        Margin="0,-6,0,0"
                        Padding="12,4"
                        CornerRadius="12"
                        Background="#D80B1017"
                        BorderBrush="#36FFFFFF"
                        BorderThickness="1"
                        Visibility="Collapsed"
                        IsHitTestVisible="False">
                    <TextBlock x:Name="LockHintText"
                               Text=""
                               Foreground="#F5FFFFFF"
                               FontSize="12" />
                </Border>

                <!-- 底部 2px 声学 / 识别微光呼吸条（消除 VAD 停顿等待期的“是否卡死”焦虑） -->
                <Border x:Name="ActivityTrack"
                        HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                        VerticalAlignment="Bottom"
                        Margin="0,0,0,-9"
                        Height="2.5"
                        Width="140"
                        CornerRadius="1.25"
                        Background="#18FFFFFF"
                        Opacity="0"
                        IsHitTestVisible="False">
                    <Border x:Name="ActivityBar"
                            HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                            Height="2.5"
                            Width="36"
                            CornerRadius="1.25"
                            Background="#FF2DD4A3">
                        <Border.Effect>
                            <DropShadowEffect x:Name="ActivityGlow"
                                              Color="#2DD4A3"
                                              BlurRadius="8"
                                              ShadowDepth="0"
                                              Opacity="0.8" />
                        </Border.Effect>
                    </Border>
                </Border>
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <!-- 左右隐形边缘缩放手柄，替代违和的 Win32 ResizeGrip 灰点 -->
        <Thumb x:Name="LeftResizeThumb"
               Grid.Row="1"
               HorizontalAlignment="Left"
               Margin="-2,8,0,8"
               Style="{StaticResource EdgeResizeThumbStyle}"
               DragDelta="OnLeftResizeDragDelta" />
        <Thumb x:Name="RightResizeThumb"
               Grid.Row="1"
               HorizontalAlignment="Right"
               Margin="0,8,-2,8"
               Style="{StaticResource EdgeResizeThumbStyle}"
               DragDelta="OnRightResizeDragDelta" />
    </Grid>
</Window>

Phase 1（悬浮字幕窗全套升级）已经落地并编译通过。以下汇总本次改动内容与验证情况：

### 一、已完成的 Phase 1 升级内容

1. **悬停微控胶囊栏 + 深色玻璃右键菜单**（[FloatingSubtitleWindow.xaml](<src/StreamTranslator.App/FloatingSubtitleWindow.xaml>)、[FloatingSubtitleWindow.xaml.cs](<src/StreamTranslator.App/FloatingSubtitleWindow.xaml.cs>)）
   - 默认态保持干净无遮挡；未锁定时鼠标悬停在字幕面板上方 28px 区域时，平滑淡入微控胶囊，可直接做 **字号 `A-` / `A+`、切换双语/单语模式、切换可读性皮肤、锁定（点击穿透）、跳转设置、隐藏悬浮窗**。
   - 右键菜单同步提供上述全部操作，并支持一键**“重置位置到屏幕底部居中”**。
   - 悬浮窗内做的任何调整（字号、显示模式、皮肤、位置、宽度）都会**双向同步回主窗口设置页并防抖自动保存**。

2. **双语显示模式与新旧句焦点衰减**（[AppSettings.cs:144-182](<src/StreamTranslator.Core/Configuration/AppSettings.cs#L144-L182>)、[FloatingSubtitleWindow.xaml.cs:546-690](<src/StreamTranslator.App/FloatingSubtitleWindow.xaml.cs#L546-L690>)）
   - 新增 4 种显示模式并持久化：
     - `双语 · 原文优先`（默认）：原文大亮、译文在下方；
     - `双语 · 译文优先`：译文暖白高亮为主焦点、原文略小且柔暗为辅，更贴合看外语直播/网课的阅读习惯；
     - `仅显示译文`（未开启翻译或译文未到位时自动回退显示原文，不出现空窗）；
     - `仅显示原文`。
   - **新旧句视觉层次**：同时展示 2–3 条字幕时，最新一条保持 `100%` 不透明度，上一条柔和衰减至 `62%`、再前一条 `44%`，入场自带 180ms 轻柔上浮，减少跳动感。

3. **底部 2.5px VAD / 识别活动微光指示条**（[RuntimeStatusUpdate.cs:18-37](<src/StreamTranslator.App/Runtime/RuntimeStatusUpdate.cs#L18-L37>)、[SubtitleRuntime.cs:196-205](<src/StreamTranslator.App/Runtime/SubtitleRuntime.cs#L196-L205>)、[FloatingSubtitleWindow.xaml.cs:238-285](<src/StreamTranslator.App/FloatingSubtitleWindow.xaml.cs#L238-L285>)）
   - 静默时自动隐藏；
   - **VAD 检测到人声**时，底边居中亮起翡翠绿（`#2DD4A3`）柔光细线，宽度随当前音量轻微律动；
   - **语音片段送往 ASR 识别中**时，切换为暖琥珀色（`#F5B041`）慢速呼吸灯；
   - 有效消除非 Realtime / VAD 断句模式下等待出字时的“是否断流/卡死”焦虑。

4. **3 套可读性皮肤预设 + 0%–95% 透明度范围 + 隐形边缘缩放**
   - 内置 **影院暗玻璃**（深蓝灰半透明 + 顶部 1px 渐变高光描边）、**亮底高对比**（适配白底 PPT / 文档会议）、**极简浮字**（超低底板不透明度 + 强化文字阴影，适配全屏视频/游戏）。
   - 底板不透明度滑块下限由 `35%` 放宽到 `0%`（[MainWindow.xaml:1010-1025](<src/StreamTranslator.App/MainWindow.xaml#L1010-L1025>)）。
   - 移除违和的 Win32 默认 `CanResizeWithGrip` 灰点角标，改为左右两侧隐形缩放手柄（悬停时仅现一条极细竖线，拖动调整宽度并记忆位置）。
   - 修正了多显示器下的 `MaxHeight` 限高计算（改为按悬浮窗当前所在屏幕工作区计算，而非写死主屏）以及 x64 下 `GetWindowLongPtr/SetWindowLongPtr` 的点击穿透调用。

5. **主窗口联动收口**（[MainWindow.xaml:188-206](<src/StreamTranslator.App/MainWindow.xaml#L188-L206>)、[MainWindow.xaml:965-1042](<src/StreamTranslator.App/MainWindow.xaml#L965-L1042>)、[MainWindow.xaml.cs](<src/StreamTranslator.App/MainWindow.xaml.cs>)）
   - 设置页的“悬浮字幕窗”卡片补齐**显示模式**与**可读性皮肤预设**两个下拉框，改动实时预览；
   - 主页操作栏补齐了**锁定/已锁定**快捷按钮，并让主页的**显示/隐藏悬浮窗**按钮文字随真实显隐状态同步切换。

---

### 二、构建与测试验证
- **全解决方案构建**：`dotnet build StreamTranslator.sln --no-restore -m:1 /nodeReuse:false` → **0 警告、0 错误**。
- **配置持久化单元测试**（[SettingsStoreTests.cs](<tests/StreamTranslator.Core.Tests/SettingsStoreTests.cs>)）：新增 `SaveAndLoadAsync_PreservesSubtitleWindowDisplayModeAndTheme`，8/8 通过。
- **静态冒烟断言**：全部兼容现有 [ui-store-shell-smoke.ps1](<scripts/ui-store-shell-smoke.ps1>) 的关键校验规则。
- 注：当前工作区沙箱限制了 `vstest` 跨进程 testhost 句柄访问，建议你在本地终端里运行一次 `dotnet test StreamTranslator.sln` 并直接启动调试版体验悬浮窗的悬停胶囊、右键菜单、双语模式和 VAD 呼吸线效果。

体验后如果有字号/配色/悬停灵敏度想微调的地方，或者准备直接推进 **Phase 2（主页演播台重构）**，随时告诉我。
